releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.19:
- Unified Barcode Scanner Engine: Seamlessly distinguishes between physical product barcodes and order/ticket numbers. Eliminated false "order not found" error when scanning items into the comanda.
- Multi-Source Barcode Resolution: Instant lookups across Products Inventory, Bar Alcohol Catalog, Order Recalls, and Delivery Hub Dispatches.
- Beer Option & Comanda Fix: Fully resolved beer selection modal hierarchy and display layering so tapping or scanning beers immediately displays serving options and adds to the order.
- Modal Hierarchy & DOM Normalization: Perfectly balanced all HTML modal tags and ensured high z-index overlays across all stations.
- Automated Integrity Inspection: Native pre-flight quality verification on all builds.
